en.app_desc: A private, offline-first Islamic Purity tracker. Manage your states of Hayd and Tuhr with certainty. No ads, no tracking, 100% private.
en.app_keywords: Tahara, Islamic Purity, Salah Tracker, Hayd, Tuhr, Ghusl, Fiqh, Muslim App, Private, Offline
en.status_desc: You are eligible for Prayer and Fasting.
en.status_hayd_desc: Prayer and Fasting are currently paused.
en.import_confirm: Overwrite current data with this backup file?
en.msg_purity_morning: It is Morning. Ensure you have prayed Fajr.
en.msg_purity_afternoon: It is Afternoon. If you became pure now, perform Ghusl and pray Zuhr and Asr.
en.msg_purity_evening: It is Evening. Ensure you pray Maghrib and Isha before sleep.
en.msg_hayd_early: Prayer and Fasting are paused. Rest is an act of worship.
en.msg_hayd_warning_hanafi: Day 10+. Exceeding 10 days is considered Istihadah in Hanafi fiqh. You may need to resume prayer.
en.msg_hayd_warning_shafi: Day 15+. Exceeding 15 days is considered Istihadah in Shafi'i fiqh. You must resume prayer.
en.msg_hayd_generic: Prayer paused. Taking care of your health is worship.
en.msg_purity_day0_morning: You just became pure. Perform Ghusl and pray Fajr.
en.msg_purity_day0_afternoon: You just became pure. Perform Ghusl. You should pray Zuhr and Asr.
en.msg_purity_day0_evening: You just became pure. Perform Ghusl. You should pray Maghrib and Isha.
en.msg_purity_general: You are in a state of purity. Keep your heart attached to Salah.
en.install_ios_desc: Tap the Share button %share_icon% and select 'Add to Home Screen' %plus_icon%.
en.msg_welcome: Welcome to Tahara. Tap below to log your first change.
en.restore_warning: Applying this will overwrite your current device data permanently.
en.explainer_cycle: Calculated by averaging the duration of your past completed Hayd cycles. Does not include your currently active cycle.
en.explainer_purity: Calculated by averaging the days between the end of one Hayd and the start of the next.
en.reminder_desc: Get a local notification to log your daily wellness.
en.notif_body: Don't forget to log your mood and symptoms today.
en.onb_1_desc: Your simple, reliable companion for tracking Hayd and Purity.
en.onb_2_desc: Your data stays on your device. No servers, no tracking, complete peace of mind.
en.onb_3_desc: Tahara calculates your averages, expected dates, and helps track your Ramadan fasting debt.

ar.app_desc: تطبيق إسلامي خاص لتتبع حالات الطهارة والحيض. احسبي أيام القضاء والصلاة بدقة وخصوصية تامة. بدون إعلانات، يعمل بدون إنترنت.

ar.msg_hayd_warning_shafi: تجاوزتِ 15 يوماً. عند الشافعية، ما زاد عن 15 يوماً يُعتبر استحاضة وتجب الصلاة.
ar.msg_hayd_generic: الصلاة متوقفة. العناية بصحتك تؤجرين عليها.

ar.msg_purity_day0_evening: طهرتِ للتو. اغتسلي، وعليكِ صلاة المغرب والعشاء.

ar.restore_warning: تطبيق هذا سيؤدي إلى استبدال بياناتك الحالية بشكل دائم.
ar.explainer_cycle: يتم حسابه بمتوسط مدة دورات الحيض السابقة المكتملة. لا يشمل دورتك الحالية المستمرة.
ar.explainer_purity: يتم حسابه بمتوسط الأيام بين نهاية حيض وبداية الذي يليه.
ar.reminder_desc: احصلي على إشعار محلي لتسجيل حالتك اليومية.
ar.notif_body: لا تنسي تسجيل حالتك المزاجية والأعراض اليوم.
ar.onb_1_desc: رفيقك البسيط والموثوق لتتبع فترات الحيض والطهر.
ar.onb_2_desc: بياناتك تبقى على جهازك. لا خوادم، لا تتبع، راحة بال تامة.
ar.onb_3_desc: تحسب طهارة متوسطاتك، وتواريخك المتوقعة، وتساعدك على تتبع قضاء الصيام.
